applicabilityBasis.summary: sFRAX is a value-accruing ERC-4626 savings share redeemable for pro-rata legacy FRAX, not a fixed-dollar payment token.

references.label: Frax sFRAX staking and redemption disclosure

genius.notes: sFRAX represents a pro-rata legacy-FRAX savings-vault claim with reward accrual. Scope is assessed separately from parent FRAX and sfrxUSD. The changing asset-per-share claim does not establish a fixed bank-dollar payment-stablecoin redemption obligation. No GENIUS legal issuer approval is asserted; MiCA is separately assessed as a yield-vault share.
